method: Raw GPU sampler diagnostic only: temporary texture uploaded from the identical half-float payload; 512 deterministic float32 coordinates; RG16F linear/clamp samples followed by clamp(U,0,1)*M. Not a cloud render, navigation proof, photographic acceptance or benchmark.
coordinatePrecision: Identical float32 UVW on CPU and GPU; storage input/output stride 16 bytes (vec4<f32>), output w=0.
referencePrecision: CPU reference decodes the same half payload and uses ideal binary64 trilinear weights/arithmetic at float32 coordinates. GPU sampling precision and f32 arithmetic may differ; bitwise identity is not assumed. Non-finite values are encoded as null and counted per channel.
sampler: 3D normalized coordinates, linear min/mag filtering, clamp-to-edge U/V/W, mip level 0, one mip.

advisoryTolerance.qualification: Inspection aid only; not a universal texture-precision guarantee or automatic material acceptance.
